title: CalibratedStrategicResponseEnvelope
description: Structured JSON schema and template for the domain-adaptive 7-point response model in Thanglish and English.

what_is_happening.description: Concise summary and objective diagnosis of the situation, runtime error, or architectural context.

why_it_happens.description: Root cause mechanism, lifecycle dynamics, event loop constraints, or economic incentives.

what_actually_matters.description: Core leverage point separating fundamental problems from noise, symptoms, and unverified assumptions.

recommended_approach.description: High-level strategic stance or idiomatic architectural pattern resolving the challenge.

how_to_execute_it.description: Production-grade, strictly-typed code snippets, CLI execution commands, or concrete action plans.

what_could_go_wrong.description: Failure modes, edge cases, second-order consequences, scale bottlenecks, and security considerations.

professional_judgment.description: Senior trade-off evaluation, reversibility classification (Type 1 vs Type 2), and long-term viability.

reversibility_type.description: Classification of decision reversibility according to Jeff Bezos's decision framework.

curiosity_trigger.description: Inspiring follow-up question or adjacent advanced concept to stimulate autonomous learning.
